scripts.dev:web: pnpm run build:spektral && pnpm run dev:web:live
scripts.dev:web:live: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; pnpm --dir packages/spektral run build:watch & WATCH_PID=$!; trap "kill $WATCH_PID 2>/dev/null || true" EXIT INT TERM; pnpm --dir apps/web run dev'
scripts.build: pnpm run build:spektral && pnpm run build:web
scripts.preview: pnpm run build:spektral && pnpm --dir apps/web run preview
scripts.deploy:web: pnpm run build:spektral && pnpm --dir apps/web run deploy
scripts.check: pnpm run build:spektral && pnpm run check:spektral && pnpm run check:web
scripts.test: pnpm run build:spektral && pnpm run test:spektral && pnpm --dir apps/web test --passWithNoTests
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:spektral && pnpm run lint:web
scripts.format: pnpm run format:root && pnpm --dir apps/web run format && pnpm --dir packages/spektral run format
scripts.format:check: pnpm run format:check:root && pnpm --dir apps/web run format:check && pnpm --dir packages/spektral run format:check
scripts.precommit: pnpm run docs:changelog:check && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint
scripts.ci:quality: pnpm run docs:changelog:check && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:spektral:build-tools && pnpm run test:spektral:bundle-tools && pnpm run build && pnpm run bundle:spektral:check && pnpm run check:spektral && pnpm run check:spektral:consumers && pnpm run check:spektral:consumers:peers && pnpm run check:web && pnpm run test:spektral:coverage && pnpm run test:spektral:perf-tools && pnpm run test:release-tools && pnpm --dir apps/web test --passWithNoTests
scripts.ci:e2e: pnpm run check:spektral:consumers:browser && pnpm --dir packages/spektral run test:e2e && pnpm --dir apps/web run test:e2e
scripts.ci: pnpm run ci:quality && pnpm run ci:e2e
